newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Oct CPI rises 0.5 pct mo/mo, 8.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech Oct CPI rises 0.5 pct mo/mo, 8.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech consumer prices rose 0.5 percent in October, putting prices 8.7 percent higher than in the same month of last year, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Friday.
CZECH CONSUMER INFLATION Oct 96 Sept 96 Oct 95
OCT CPI BASKET COMPONENTS CHANGE MO/MO CHANGE YR/YR

Note. September basket component changes in brackets. All changes are rises except where stated. Prices have risen 20.9 percent from the average level for 1994 while the sliding average in October using a 1993 base was 8.7 percent. Basket of goods and services is unchanged from 1995.
The CSU said that the biggest influence on the October inflation rate was food, drinks and tobacco products which rose 1.0 percent in the month and clothing, which rose 1.2 percent.
Together these two categories accounted for 80 percent of the overall inflation figure.
